data.description:
testing_mode: RED

Write failing tests for format_ticket_id() in ticket-lib.sh and ticket.display_mode config key parsing. Tests must be RED before T8a implementation.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given: display_mode=canonical in config; When: format_ticket_id(id) called; Then: returns 16-hex canonical ID unchanged
- Given: display_mode=alias in config; When: format_ticket_id(id) called; Then: returns adj-noun-noun alias from CREATE event data.alias
- Given: display_mode=short in config; When: format_ticket_id(id) called; Then: returns shortest unambiguous prefix (>= 4 chars)
- Given: display_mode absent from config; When: format_ticket_id(id) called; Then: defaults to canonical (returns 16-hex ID)
- Given: display_mode=unrecognized_value in config; When: format_ticket_id(id) called; Then: defaults to canonical
- Given: display_mode=alias but ticket has no data.alias (pre-migration ticket); When: called; Then: falls back to canonical

Test file: tests/scripts/test-ticket-lib.sh (add new test functions)
depends_on: T7 (0689-abdd)
Story DD coverage: SC5 (display cascade config)
Retry budget: 2 attempts
data.title: RED: tests for format_ticket_id() and display_mode config parsing
